name: Island Survive
hook: Chop, build a fire, and last the night together.
how: By day you chop trees, mine rocks and craft an axe, a pickaxe and a spear. At night crabs crawl out of the sea, so keep the campfire fed with wood and fence the camp in: firelight burns them.
controls: WASD and mouse, hold click to chop, mine, fight and feed the fire, 1 to 5 to craft, or the thumb stick and USE button
uses: The camp is remembered by the players who built it: whoever comes back first brings back its fires, fences and day count.
The host's browser runs the day and night, every crab and every fallen tree; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The most nights in a row each player lasted without being knocked out.
Bot islanders chop, mine, build fences and fight beside you until enough people join.
Every islander, swing, crab and campfire shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Add berry bushes that heal you when you eat them
Add a giant boss crab every fifth night
Let players build a raft and sail to a second island
